draft_en.subject: Price list, MOQ, warranty — Topica
draft_en.body:
Hi Bayar,

You asked for price list, MOQ and warranty in October 2025; I sent the download links and a datasheet but not the three answers — here they are in one line: MOQ 1 pc; warranty 1 year on commercial (STC) models and 3 years on industrial (STI) models, lifetime technical support, and the three prices most people ask for first (USD EXW, 15-day validity): 16-port PoE L2 managed STC-2216GPM (16 × PoE + 2 × GE + 2 × SFP, 200 W) $141.7; 8-port PoE L2+ managed STC-28DGGPM (8 × PoE + 2 × 1G/2.5G SFP) $80.7; 24-port PoE L2+ managed STC-424XGGPM-280W (24 × PoE + 4 × 10G SFP+) $180 — my mail of 4 August quoted $170 for this one; the yuan has moved from 7.2 to 6.7 against the dollar since, hence $180 today. The full table follows once I know which brand you carry.

One question: which switch / media-converter brand do you carry in Mongolia today, so I can map our equivalent models instead of sending the whole catalog? Shipping is by road via Erenhot or by air to Ulaanbaatar, your choice.

Best regards,
Elsa
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
